verdict.rationale: Supabase ships an official, documented CLI (`supabase init`/`start`) that runs the full stack locally or in CI. It can be pinned per project via npm, serves the MCP server locally at localhost:54321/mcp, and exposes agent-pullable checks like `supabase db advisors`, with a CLI reference corpus offered to agents via llms.txt. Community users independently confirm using `supabase start` hands-on. Missing for 10: documented agent-oriented CLI ergonomics (structured/JSON output, non-interactive auth flow), deeper command-reference evidence in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Supabase CLI enables you to run the entire Supabase stack locally, on your machine or in a CI environment.
When using Supabase CLI for local development, the MCP server is available at http://localhost:54321/mcp.
Install the Supabase CLI as a project dev dependency with `npm install supabase --save-dev`, so the version is pinned per project.
